visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Reverse a Linked List
visualizerParams.description: Walk the list once and turn each next pointer around. Remember the next node before overwriting the pointer, or the rest of the list is lost.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value, next=None):
        self.value = value
        self.next = next


def reverse(head):
    prev = None
    while head is not None:
        nxt = head.next
        head.next = prev
        prev = head
        head = nxt
    return prev


head = Node(1, Node(2, Node(3, Node(4))))
node = reverse(head)
values = []
while node is not None:
    values.append(node.value)
    node = node.next
print(values)
